meta.title: Marble Tunis Carthage - Timeless Elegance
meta.description: Luxury marble experts, from quarry to your interior. Discover our exceptional collections and 3D configurator.

hero.title: Timeless Elegance in Marble
hero.subtitle: From quarry to your interior, we transform stone into works of art. Since 1989, Marble Tunis Carthage combines artisanal expertise and innovation to elevate your spaces.

video.title: Our Craft in Motion
video.description: Dive into the heart of our creation process. From extraction to finishing, every step is carried out with precision and passion that guarantee an exceptional product. This video illustrates our commitment to quality and Tunisian craftsmanship.

usine.title: Our Factory
usine.description: Discover our marble transformation workshops, where artisanal tradition meets modern technology. Every stone is cut, polished, and finished with expertise passed down since 1989.

products.title: Our Exceptional Products
products.description: Explore our marble collection, available in a variety of colors and finishes to enhance all your projects, from the most classic to the most daring.

marbre-blanc-carrare.description: Carrara white marble is synonymous with pure elegance. Its delicate grey veins create a subtle contrast perfect for luxurious kitchens and bathrooms.

marbre-noir-marquina.description: Deep black with striking white veins, this Spanish marble brings a dramatic, sophisticated touch to any modern space.

travertin-beige.description: Beige travertine offers mineral warmth and authentic texture, ideal for Mediterranean interiors and elegant flooring.

granit-rouge-imperial.description: Imperial red granite with deep reflections, perfect for bold countertops and standout architectural details.

marbre-emeraude.description: A rare marble with deep green tones and white veins, ideal for bold, natural focal points.

onyx-honey.description: Translucent honey onyx with golden veins, chosen for backlit features and surfaces that capture the light.

configurator.title: Visualize Your Project
configurator.description: Use our interactive 3D configurator to test our marbles in your own space. Bring your ideas to life and choose the perfect finish before you even begin.

popup.title: Choose your space to visualize
popup.selectedMessage: You selected: {room} — the next step is coming soon

projets.title: Our Projects
projets.description: Explore a selection of our completed work: villas, hotels, offices, and public spaces enhanced by Tunisian marble. Each project reflects our craftsmanship and commitment to excellence.

trusted.title: They trusted us
trusted.description: A network of diverse and prestigious clients around the world.

footer.blurb: Founded in 1989, Marble Tunis Carthage is a leader in marble transformation in Tunisia. Our passion for stone and commitment to quality set us apart.
